description.value: Nourish Kitchen & Cafe is a casual, vegetable-forward restaurant operating out of a Heritage home in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, offering brunch seven days a week and dinner Wednesday through Saturday. The menu is heavily plant-based and locally sourced, with many vegan and gluten-free options, and the restaurant also hosts private events and offers gift cards. Touring cyclists looking for a restorative plant-forward meal close to the inner harbour would find this a welcoming stop.
